I posted the answer in #coastal-team: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

Two sources back that date. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2 says "account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap from 12/8 also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

The recap adds that she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use 11/3 if the tracker records the official change, or 11/22 if it records when Kwame actually took over.
